calao.name: Calão (Luanda street Portuguese)
calao.about: Luanda's street Portuguese: quick, warm and full of Kimbundu words like bué, kota and mambo, plus the city's own slang (camba, kumbu, bazar, bumbar). The talk of the candongueiros, the markets and kuduro.

greet: Hey, long time! How is the family?
Hello, friend! Where are you off to?
Morning! Did you get here before the traffic?
reply: All good, thank you, and you?
Fine, fine, the day is moving.
Good, just tired from the traffic.
sunny: The sun is strong today, stay in the shade.
Hot one today, I need a cold drink.
Beautiful sky over the bay this morning.
In this heat even the zungueiras are resting under the trees.
rain: Rain is coming, the streets will fill up fast.
Heavy rain, the candongueiros will be slow.
Let's wait here until it passes.
Rain in Luanda means traffic everywhere.
At least the rain cools things down.
bye: Go well, call me when you get there.
busy: Sorry, I'm in a rush, my candongueiro is leaving!
Running to a meeting in Talatona, talk later.
Can't stop, I'm late for work.
Heading to the market before it closes.
I'll call you tonight, I'm busy now!

greet: Olá, há quanto tempo! Como vai a família?
sunny: Que sol! Dia bom para ir à Ilha.
O céu está lindo sobre a baía.
Com este calor, só uma água gelada.
rain: Com esta chuva, as ruas vão encher.
Vamos esperar aqui até a chuva passar.
Está a chover muito, não há táxi.
busy: Tenho uma reunião em Talatona, falamos depois.

greet: Xé, mano, qual é o mambo?
sunny: Hoje o sol tá bué quente, mano!
Calor bué! Vamos bazar para a Ilha?
Dia bonito para dar uma volta na Marginal.
Esse sol tá a bater forte, camba.
rain: Xé, chuva! As ruas vão encher bué.
Bazamos antes que a chuva aperte!
Com essa chuva o candongueiro vai demorar bué.
Chuva em Luanda é sério, mano, cuidado.
busy: Tou a bumbar, mano, falamos depois!
Tou atrasado, o candongueiro tá a sair!
Agora não dá, camba, tou bué ocupado.
Tou a correr, depois te ligo!

landmarks: Igreja de Nossa Senhora dos Remédios

small_talk: Deolinda Rodrigues was blocked all morning, I took a kupapata in the end.
Let's walk the Marginal this evening, the breeze off the bay is lovely.
Going over to Mussulo on Saturday, the boats leave early.
The candongueiro to Viana was full before I even got to the paragem.
My aunt is making muamba de galinha and funje on Sunday, you have to come.
Kizomba night on the Ilha on Friday, are you in?
Bought jinguba from the zungueira at the corner, still warm.
The Palancas Negras play this weekend, we are watching at the kota's place.
It is cacimbo now, mornings in Luanda are grey and cool.
Fresh fish at the Ilha this morning, the boats came in early.
